summary: SS Innovations International filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a $21.025 million secured convertible promissory note sold to an institutional investor for $20 million under an October 9, 2026 purchase agreement. The note pays 8.75% interest compounded daily, matures 36 months after funding, and is convertible into common stock (Nasdaq: SSII). Collateral includes company and SSI IP Holdings intellectual property and subsidiary equity, excluding the Indian operating subsidiary SSI-India; subsidiaries other than SSI-India guarantee it. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and conversion pricing mechanics.
